info.name: OrderSphere - Feature Coverage
info.description:
Assertion-based coverage of every implemented feature listed in CLAUDE.md that the Full Order Flow collection doesn't already exercise: auth & RBAC, inventory catalog/restock/backorders, payment methods, payment idempotency and transient-failure retries, shipment returns, notification preferences and delivery, service discovery, the RabbitMQ topology, and circuit breaker registration.

Run top to bottom (`npx newman run postman/feature-coverage.postman_collection.json`) against the docker-compose stack. Every run uses fresh users/SKU suffixed with {{runId}}, so it is re-runnable. Async steps poll themselves (3s, up to 20 tries).

The RabbitMQ requests use the docker-compose default management credentials (ordersphere/ordersphere).

Resilience4j: ordersphere-orders wraps its calls to inventory, payment and shipping in circuit breakers.
